notes: Three-level subsumption lattice over the leaf vocabulary of two blind retranslations (seats A and B) of 39 policy clauses. Four families are kept strictly separate: atoms, inputs, outputs, and the leaf values of the 20 dimensions. LEAF: raw terms from both seats, with exact paraphrases merged into one canonical leaf (e.g. A 'cliched_phrase' + B 'cliche' -> 'cliche'; A 'no_diagnosing_of_the_user' + B 'unlicensed_diagnosis_of_the_person_in_the_conversation' -> 'unlicensed_diagnosis_of_the_user'); near-neighbours that are not paraphrases stay as distinct leaves and meet at the mid level. MID: a grouping several leaves genuinely share, named in the leaves' own language. TOP: a small set of broad classes per family (9 atoms / 8 inputs / 8 outputs / 9 dimensions). Dimension leaves are clustered within their own dimension at the mid level, but the tops are cross-dimension classes so that dimensions_top carries information beyond the dimension name. 'dimensions_leaf' is included alongside the requested dimensions_mid/dimensions_top so the canonical leaf per dimension is recoverable. Single-leaf mids exist only where a leaf is genuinely isolated in the pooled data (e.g. 'undefined_value_word', 'costly_action_gating', 'section_scope_announcement'). Every leaf in the lattice is attested in at least one seat; every seat term maps to exactly one leaf, mid, and top.
